notes: Direct HTTP fetch throughout (Tier 1), no WAF, matching prior access notes for SR111/fonQ. Checked: main nav mega-menu (grepped full homepage HTML for outlet/nieuw/bestseller/populair/meest-verkocht/favoriet/trending terms), the site's XML sitemap index (4 sub-sitemaps, sitemap1-4.xml, combined into 1982 unique /collections/ slugs, grepped for best|populair|verkocht|favoriet|trending|top-), and the human-readable /sitemap page listing ~2419 site links (verified independently; a stale same-scratchpad cached copy from a different worker's earlier fetch surfaced the candidate URL, which was then fetched and inspected fresh by this worker). Tried the site search endpoint (/search?q=bestseller, ?q=populair) but results are client-rendered (no SSR nbResults), so nav+sitemap coverage was relied on instead (far more exhaustive than search). No literal 'Bestsellers'/'Best Sellers'/'Meest verkocht'/'Populair'/'Top sellers' merchandising PLP exists anywhere in nav, sitemap, or collection slug list. The only non-editorial candidate found is /collections/best-gewaardeerde-producten ('Best Rated Products') -- its own on-page SEO meta description explicitly frames it as 'topfavorieten'/'klantenfavorieten'/'populaire woonitems' (top favorites/customer favorites/popular home items), matching the Bestsellers concept's local-language equivalents, even though its slug/sort criterion is customer star-rating rather than sales volume. Recorded with a flag for reviewer confirmation. Excluded as non-PLP/editorial: blog posts 'binnenkijken-de-voorjaarsfavorieten-van-theo-bert-pot-1' and 'favoriete-items-die-nieuwe-routines-ondersteunen' (both use 'favorieten' but are inspiration/blog articles, not product listings), and /collections/favorites-recap-2025-by-fonq ('by fonQ favorieten', a single-brand year-end recap page, not a general bestsellers merchandising PLP -- not opened further as its own scope is a single third-party brand's recap, not the site's bestseller concept).

Confirm this is the intended Bestsellers-equivalent listing for this site, or that no Bestsellers row should be recorded at all.
